The "proxy control" group is selected through propensity score methods using the package {rollmatch}. We matched 1:1 on country, time from diagnosis to enrollment, enrollment year, study visit at entry, disease status, age at entry, race, and education level. {rollmatch} selects the control patient as well as the theoretical entry time for the control patient to best match the patients in the intervention arm.

Note that 12 EMPRO patients were excluded due to the TrueNTH technical bug (it seems that 4 were removed from the database or data was never entered), and an additional 4 EMPRO patients were excluded because they had no EMPRO consent date entered.

There were three EMPRO patients who were not matched, but since this is an interim analysis we will continue to monitor if we have trouble matching these patients.

### **Table 1:** Characteristics of patients in the intervention group and proxy control group

```{r}
#create demographic table by invention and control (arm variable = groups)
empro_data %>%
  dplyr::select(arm,
         country,
         age_baseline,
         race_gp,
         diag_enroll,
         year_emp_enrollment,
         enrollment_month1,
         crpc_per,
         education,
         yn_eortc_0,
         yn_eortc_3,
         yn_eortc_6,
         yn_eortc_9,
         dead) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = arm,
              missing = "ifany",
              missing_text = "N missing",
              type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
              statistic = all_continuous() ~ c("{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                                               "{min}, {max}")) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_header(label = "",stat_1 = "**Proxy Control** N = {n}", 
                           stat_2 = "**Intervention** N = {n}")

# to output to .docx:
# tbl %>%
#   as_flex_table() %>%
#   flextable::save_as_docx()
```

### **Table 2:** Characteristics of patients in the control arm, overall and by site

```{r}
#create demographic table of control arm by site
empro_data %>%
  filter(arm == "control") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site,
         age_baseline,
         race_gp,
         diag_enroll,
         year_emp_enrollment,
         enrollment_month1,
         crpc_per,
         education,
         yn_eortc_0,
         yn_eortc_3,
         yn_eortc_6,
         yn_eortc_9,
         eortc_0,
         eortc_3,
         eortc_6,
         eortc_9,
         dead
         ) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = site,
              missing = "ifany",
              missing_text = "N missing",
              type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
              statistic = all_continuous() ~ c("{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                                               "{min}, {max}")) %>%
  gtsummary::add_overall() %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_header(label = "")

# to output to .docx:
# tbl %>%
#   as_flex_table() %>%
#   flextable::save_as_docx()
```

### **Table 4:** Secondary outcomes of patients in the intervention arm, overall and by site

```{r}
#create table of secondary outcomes for intervention arm by site
empro_data %>%
  filter(arm == "intervention") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site,
         clinician_contact,
         self_mgmt_soft,
         self_mgmt_hard,
         n_visit_soft_trigger,
         n_total_soft_trigger,
         n_visit_hard_trigger,
         n_total_hard_trigger,
         pain_hard_trigger) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = site,
              missing = "ifany",
              missing_text = "N missing",
              type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
              statistic = all_continuous() ~ c("{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                                               "{min}, {max}"),
              digits = list(all_continuous() ~ c(0))) %>%
  gtsummary::add_overall() %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_header(label = "")

# to output to .docx:
# tbl %>%
#   as_flex_table() %>%
#   flextable::save_as_docx()
```
